_comment: Per-tenant (employer_domain) first successful pull date — the day this pipeline onboarded the tenant. Records whose first_seen is on/before this date are onboarding BACKFILL and never count as 'new' (see normalize/model.py compute_is_new). Keyed on employer_domain, NOT source_id: tenants sharing a platform (oracle_orc: kroger+providence 08-31 vs sherwin 09-13; workday: multicare 08-31 vs uhaul 09-10; radancy_tb: allied 09-02 vs sysco 09-12 vs ontrac 09-15) onboarded on different days. Set ONCE at onboarding and never updated (append a line in the add-tenant SOP). Seeded 2026-09-16 from min(first_seen) per employer_domain. A tenant missing from this map falls back to min(first_seen), which drifts as its earliest backfill retires — prefer keeping this explicit.
